description: The content of a broadsheet edition: a front page of other people's site.standard.document records, picked and arranged by an editor. Used as the `content` of a site.standard.document whose `site` is the editor's broadsheet publication. Every slot points at the original document; nothing is copied.

number.description: The edition's number in this broadsheet.

slots.description: In render order: one lead, then up to two seconds, three features and four briefs.

item.description: The site.standard.document picked, as it was when picked.

headline.description: The editor's headline, shown instead of the document's title on this page only.

deck.description: The editor's deck, shown instead of the document's description on this page only.
